office_does: The Assessor values property in Mason County for property tax under state rules and reports annually to the Department of Revenue.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Assessor Patti McLean (Prefers Independent Party), in office since 2019, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Mason County Assessor since 2019, who started at the office's front counter in 1991; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Assessor since 2019, in the office since 1991 [S1]
Runs as an Independent, saying local offices should remain nonpartisan [S1]
Re-elected in 2022 with 55.4% over George Blush [S2]
